newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ says important to act early in policy.
newsitem.headline: BOJ says important to act early in policy.

text.p: Bank of Japan (BOJ) governor Yasuo Matsushita told a parliamentary committee on Thursday that it was important to conduct pre-emptive policy steps in order to realise continued growth without inflation.

"The priority in monetary policy rests in stabilising prices for continued economic growth without inflation. At the same time, we believe it is important to act promptly on policy steps while keeping watch over asset prices and money supply movements," Matsushita said.
He also said that the central bank believed it was not appropriate to put too much emphasis on monetary policy management in order to correct external imbalances, reflecting past experiences.
